min_gap.definition: per task: min(|a-b|, |a-c|, |b-c|) over its 3 seeds

rounds.definition: per cell type, one row per 3-seed task in order: the nine class counts accumulated over all previous rounds, and the rank each of this round's seeds' classes held in that same prior state (rank 1 = most-selected class so far, ties shared)
